notes.title: 🥔 POTATO MODE ADDED 🥔
notes.content:
HELLO, BOBERS!

We’re excited to share the latest improvements for The Hole.

What’s New?

1️⃣ Shadow Toggle:
You can now turn off shadows in the settings! This option is perfect for lower-end computers, helping to prevent crashes and reduce unnecessary GPU freezes.

2️⃣ “Potato Mode”:
If you’re looking for even more optimization or just want a nostalgic retro vibe, we’ve added Potato Mode! Relive the charm of games from the ‘90s with this feature.

Beyond Optimization:

On some computers, players couldn’t ascend the infinite staircase on Day 2. The loop is now fixed, and you can climb freely!

We’ve patched the hole on the matryoshka doll level. No more falling into the Backrooms!

Thank you so much for your support and feedback! Thanks to you, we identified these issues and made the game even better.

If you have suggestions, comments, or questions, drop by our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/WhHy7xGW or email us at: superboberbros@gmail.com.

Happy holidays,
The Bober Bros Team

notes.title: Day 1 Patch: A small but important wooden plank!
notes.content: We fixed the bug with climbing the stairs - we put a wooden plank under it. Now not a single step is not a hindrance!

notes.title: Day 0.5 Patch: Fighting bugs ASAP!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t move after looking through the peephole. You're free to roam again!
[*] Fixed a bug where the game froze if you looked through the peephole with a beer. Beer compatibility improved!
[*] Removed the ability to leave the hole with the drawing when you weren’t supposed to. Naughty, naughty!
[*] Fixed a bug with the numbers on the staircase. They’ve been disciplined.
[*] Fixed a bug with the second beer in the matryoshka. Only one beer per nesting doll, please!
[/list]

notes.title: The Hole Drops December 5th! 🕳️
notes.content:
Yo! 💀The wait is almost over — The Hole is coming DECEMBER 5th! 🕳️✨

👁️ [b]WHAT TO EXPECT[/b]

Your peaceful evening is shattered by your neighbor’s constant drilling, but it’s the *holes* in your walls that reveal a much darker story.

🎮 A short, 40-minute psychological horror game.

👾 Nostalgic PS2-style graphics with a modern twist.

🌍 Fully in Interslavic, offering a rich cultural experience.

👻 NO cheap jumpscares — only the raw, oppressive atmosphere of real-world fears.

We poured our hearts into this one, focusing on domestic horror to ask tough questions about abuse, isolation, and survival. It’s unsettling but important — and we hope it resonates with you. ❤️
